page_title: PIS 1-2 LEC | Pisa v Lecce 01/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Daniele Doveri has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
90+3' Substitution. Omri Gandelman (Lecce) replaces Santiago Pierotti.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Pisa.

90+2' That was a nice football moment. Michel Aebischer (Pisa) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Wladimiro Falcone guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! Pisa have been awarded a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' The referee has issued a yellow card to Henrik Meister (Pisa).

89' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the right post, but Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a decent save to thwart him.
88' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) for his blatant foul.
88' A cross into the box from Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) is cleared.
87' This should have been a goal! Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) sends a killer pass into the box, but Francesco Camarda can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession.

85' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
84' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
82' Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa) is cautioned by the referee.
81' Oscar Hiljemark prepares a substitution. Ebenezer Akinsanmiro is replaced by Rafiu Durosinmi (Pisa).
81' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rosen Bozhinov.
80' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Francesco Camarda (Lecce) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
78' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

78' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Pisa.
78' An attempted cross from Danilo Veiga (Lecce) is cleared.
75' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
73' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
71' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Walid Cheddira and he is replaced by Francesco Camarda (Lecce).
71' Here comes a substitution. Lameck Banda is given a rest as he is replaced by Gaby Jean (Lecce).
70' Here is a change. Filip Stojilkovic is going off and Oscar Hiljemark gives the last tactical orders to Henrik Meister (Pisa).
70' That will be all from Isak Vural who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa).
69' The Pisa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up. 54:46 – the latest ball possession ratio.
68' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
67' The ball goes behind for a corner. Pisa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
66' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.

65' 1 - 2 Goal! Santiago Pierotti plays in Walid Cheddira (Lecce), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 1:2.
64' The substitution is prepared. Idrissa Toure (Pisa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Samuele Angori.

63' The ball rebounds out to Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.

63' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.

62' Lameck Banda (Lecce) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
61' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Michel Aebischer (Pisa) receives a yellow card!
59' Rosen Bozhinov (Pisa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wladimiro Falcone, who smothers the ball.
58' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
56' 1 - 1 What a hit! Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
55' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.

52' 0 - 1 GOAL! A great pass finds Lameck Banda (Lecce) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from mid range. It’s now 0:1.
51' Pisa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
50' One of the players from Pisa times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
50' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) takes the corner but it's cleared.

49' Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) makes contact with a cross and strikes a shot towards the bottom right corner that lacks the power to find the back of the net, but the goalkeeper still has to pull off a marvellous diving save to keep his effort out. Pisa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
48' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
47' Lameck Banda (Lecce) launches a cross from the corner, but Adrian Semper is alert to thwart the effort.
47' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Lecce win a corner.
46' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Adrian Semper intercepts the ball.
46' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) trips an opposition player and Daniele Doveri signals a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Lecce.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
44' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
43' Yellow card. Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
41' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Daniele Doveri who sees an offensive foul.

41' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
37' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
34' The game is interrupted. Oumar Ngom (Lecce) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
33' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) meets a cross inside the box, but Adrian Semper wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
32' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) is penalised for holding. Daniele Doveri signals a set piece. Lecce will take a free kick.

31' That was close! Stefano Moreo (Pisa) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
29' The free kick from long range, taken by Pisa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' Oumar Ngom (Lecce) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Pisa win a free kick.
28' Lameck Banda (Lecce) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
27' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:1. The number of shots on goal at present is 2:1.

26' What an opportunity! Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes low towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
25' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for an infringement.
25' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a chip pass into the box, but Adrian Semper is quickest to intercept the ball.
22' Samuele Angori (Pisa) will deliver the corner kick.

21' Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his low drive towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. The ball is out of play and Pisa manage to earn a corner.
21' Handball! A player from Lecce handled the ball.
18' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Doveri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

16' Golden chance! Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
14' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Wladimiro Falcone to dive and make a save.

13' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Michel Aebischer (Pisa) is going to have a crack himself.
12' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Pisa win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
11' The Lecce players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.

10' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
9' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
8' Lameck Banda (Lecce) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Pisa will have a throw-in.
8' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
6' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) touches the ball with his hand.
4' Some great play by Lameck Banda (Lecce) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Adrian Semper sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
4' Wladimiro Falcone displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
3' Lameck Banda (Lecce) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
3' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
1' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Pisa will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri was nominated as the referee for this game.
